canonical_project: Burkina Faso National Big Data Center (2028)
owner: Government of Burkina Faso / Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications (Minister Dr Aminata Zerbo/Sabané)
notes: Announced national 'Big Data Center' to be completed by 2028, positioned as the next step after the January 2026 modular government data centers, intended to repatriate all public-administration and private-sector digital data currently hosted abroad, and reported as intended to be open to private sector and civil society. Location not officially specified (Ouagadougou assumed); size/capacity not disclosed.
